jobs.title: Sr. Director, Technical Program Management AI/ML
jobs.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the   power   to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Senior Director, Technical Program Management AI/ML

45961

Overview and Responsibilities

Job Summary:

The Senior Director of Technical Program Management (AI) collaborates with engineering management. They lead the development and growth of AI-driven platforms and systems. Enhance capabilities within the Consumer AI organization.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, product, and business strategy translating AI concepts into scalable, production-grade systems that deliver measurable impact.

The ideal candidate brings deep systems thinking, deep technical judgment, hands-on experience building AI solutions, and the adaptability to lead in fast-pace, experimental AI environments.

They will oversee a portfolio of AI/ML investments, lead a team of senior program management leaders, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic AI Portfolio Leadership

Own PMO oversight of the end-to-end AI/ML portfolio, including long-range we plan and select where to invest. We also measure the results based on specific goals.

Enable software product operating models that support high-volume experimentation, rapid learning cycles, and continuous improvement.

As the team and AI / ML products scale, introduce the correct level of lean process, while still supporting innovation and autonomy.

Establish planning rhythms, reviews, and metrics. Ensuring accountability and give senior management visibility.

Drive clarity on priorities and tradeoffs across AI investments to maximize long-term leverage and impact.

Establish and track portfolio-level success metrics connecting model performance, adoption, and business outcomes.

Serve as a key contributor on the PMO AI solutions team, actively collaborating in the ideation, design, and build of AI-generated tools and automation workflows to impact productivity, efficiency, and project/people data insights.

Program Management: Risk, Dependencies, and Go-to-Market Integration

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate technical, delivery, and systemic risks along with recommended mitigation strategies and decision points.

Own dependency management across multiple teams, platforms, and product surfaces, ensuring sequencing, interfaces, and handoffs are clearly understood and actively managed.

Drive issue resolution for complex, cross-team challenges by facilitating rapid root-cause analysis, aligning stakeholders on tradeoffs, and ensuring timely, durable outcomes.

Partner closely with adjacent engineering, platform, and product teams to ensure AI/ML capabilities are production-ready, scalable, and aligned to go-to-market timelines.

Synthesize and communicate clear, data-driven insights on program health, risks, and strategic tradeoffs to engineering management and executive stakeholders.

Lead executive-level discussions on program health, delivery progress, and measurable outcomes across AI initiatives.

Basic Qualifications:

12 + years of experience in Technical Program Management, or similar roles.

Proven experience leading AI / ML specific portfolio-level programs spanning multiple teams and product areas, with a focus on consumer- facing capabilities and business growth.

Deep knowledge of agile, lean, and iterative delivery models, with the ability to adapt them to non-traditional workflows.

You should have remarkable communication skills. You need to be proficient in managing stakeholders. You must be able to work well with others.People management skills, including experience managing managers.

Relevant technical certifications such as cloud platforms, AI/MLfoundations, Generative AI, Technical Program/Product Management, or

Technical/Engineering.

Demonstrated hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools, low-code/no- code, for prototyping, automation, and analysis.

Additional Qualifications:

Knowledge with the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data sourcing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Experience with experimentation frameworks including A/B and multivariate testing, offline vs. online evaluation, and model iteration

loops.

Knowledge of model performance metrics and tradeoffs (accuracy, latency, bias, explainability).

Experience supporting applied ML use cases such as personalization and recommendation systems, search and ranking, content knowledge, or generative AI for text, image, or video.

Director, Product Management
247Sports
Department: 247Sports
Reports to: VP & Head of 247Sports
Location: Nashville, TN (on-site)
Employment type: Full-time
Level: Director

About 247Sports:
247Sports is a leading destination for college sports recruiting coverage, player rankings, and team-focused fan communities. We combine deep evaluation data and expert analysis with a premium VIP subscription experience for the most dedicated fans in college sports.
Position summary

247Sports is hiring a Director of Product Management to own the product strategy and roadmap for our web and data experiences. This is a results-driven leadership role centered on turning the deep evaluation data 247Sports collects into premium, subscriber-facing products that make our VIP membership materially more valuable. The Director will lead product development across the recruiting database (RDB), scouting and evaluation tooling, and subscriber growth, and will partner closely with editorial, scouting, engineering, and site publishers to drive measurable results.
This is a full-time, on-site role based in our Nashville office. We are open to discussing relocation timing for the right candidate.

Key responsibilities:

Product strategy & VIP subscriber value
●    Own the product vision and roadmap for 247Sports web and data products, with a focus on driving VIP subscription value, retention, and acquisition.
●    Lead the flagship initiative to productize proprietary evaluation data, including scouting reports, verified and unverified measurables, track times, and cross-sport intel, into front-facing content and interactive tools that show subscribers how and why players are ranked.
●    Define and prioritize premium features such as player evaluation profiles, searchable and sortable measurables and testing data, cross-sport intel, and scout-grade comparison tools.

Scouting & recruiting product partnership
●    Partner with the scouting and recruiting teams to build and expand the internal evaluation tooling they rely on day to day, including the scouting-information repository, evaluation tracking, and rankings workflows.
●    Lead development of depth charts and impact ratings, connecting scouting data directly to consumer-facing products.

Recruiting database (RDB)
●    Own the roadmap to elevate the RDB product experience and establish it as the primary destination for premium evaluation data.

Product marketing & growth
●    Partner with site publishers on strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and subscriptions.
●    Tie data-driven product initiatives directly to measurable subscriber acquisition and retention outcomes.

Cross-functional leadership
●    Lead product initiatives across engineering, editorial, scouting, and design, setting direction, prioritizing the roadmap, and driving execution.
●    Provide QA, project management, and site-production oversight as needed across product areas.
●    Support the 247Sports app roadmap, contributing on the web, backend, and data components that feed it, including Player Rankings.

Qualifications

Required
●    10+ years of product management experience, including roadmap ownership.
●    Demonstrated track record of building and shipping complex, data-driven products from the ground up.
●    Proven ability to translate large or complex data sets into consumer-facing products and tools.
●    Strong background in subscription or membership products, with a focus on driving retention and growth.
●    Experience leading cross-functional teams and partnering with editorial, engineering, and business stakeholders.
●    Excellent product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills.

Preferred
●    Deep familiarity with college sports, recruiting, and player evaluation.
●    Experience founding or leading a product or business built on sports data or recruiting tools.
●    Background working directly with scouting or evaluation data and the teams that produce it.

Product Management, Merchandising (International)

Job Summary
Paramount+ is seeking a Product Manager, Merchandising (International) to own how audiences across international markets discover and engage with content on our streaming platform. This role is responsible for defining and spearheading the international merchandising strategy and execution model, ensuring content is positioned effectively across regions while scaling through data‑driven workflows and automation.

Operating at the intersection of Product, Programming, Applied Machine Learning, Marketing, Design, and Operations, this role translates global and regional content priorities into clear merchandising strategies, measurable outcomes, and repeatable operating mechanisms. The Product Manager will balance global consistency with local relevance, ensuring international discovery experiences are intuitive, compliant, and optimized for engagement and retention.

Key Responsibilities
●    Define and drive the international on‑platform merchandising operations, including content positioning, prioritization, and lifecycle management across markets.
●    Establish consistent merchandising principles for international markets while enabling regional flexibility where audience needs or regulatory requirements differ.

●    Partner with Product and Engineering teams to inform platform capabilities, tooling improvements, and roadmap decisions that enable scalable merchandising execution.
●    Ensure merchandising workflows are designed to support global scale while minimizing manual intervention through automation and data-driven decision making.
●    Partner closely with Programming teams to align on content intent, timing, and regional considerations.
●    Collaborate with Applied Machine Learning (AMLG) teams to define rules, constraints, and success metrics that guide personalization and automation in international markets.
●    Work with Marketing and Design partners to ensure on‑platform experience aligns with campaign objectives and brand standards, while retaining merchandising accountability.
●    Partner with Legal, Privacy, and regional stakeholders to ensure international merchandising experiences meet regulatory and compliance requirements.
●    Champion experimentation across international markets, ensuring merchandising strategies are testable and supported by solid metadata, creative, and operational foundations.
●    Oversee monitoring and reporting to evaluate merchandising performance and surface insights that drive continuous optimization across markets.

Basic Qualifications
●    3+ years in product management, content merchandising, or content discovery for consumer facing digital products at scale.
●    Proven track record owning complex, cross‑functional initiatives in a global environment, with accountability for measurable outcomes.

●    Bachelor’s degree required; technical or quantitative discipline preferred.
●    Strong applied knowledge of data-driven methodologies, including behavioral analytics and segmentation, to inform merchandising decisions and drive subscriber level outcomes.
●    Experience defining content architecture and curation strategy across platforms, with working knowledge of how platform dependencies and metadata quality affect the consumer experience.
●    Demonstrated ability to partner substantively with ML and engineering teams on personalization and recommendation systems, including evaluating outputs and defining constraints that reflect merchandising intent.
●    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across product, technical, and creative teams.

Preferred Qualifications
●    Experience supporting international or regional discovery strategies for a global streaming or media platform.
●    Proficiency with analytics and data science tooling (such as Adobe Analytics, Looker, Tableau, Python, or SQL)
●    Working knowledge of how personalization and ranking systems are built, with experience contributing to the signals and inputs that shape content recommendations.
●    Proven track record designing and interpreting experimentation programs, including A/B and multivariate testing, to drive merchandising optimization.
●    Experience working across multiple time zones and cultural contexts.

Senior Product Manager, Sign-Up Flow Optimization
Team: Applied Intelligence
Company: Paramount Streaming (Paramount+, Pluto TV)

About the Role
Paramount is building the next generation of personalization and discovery across our global streaming platforms, and we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to contribute to high-impact initiatives across the Paramount+ and Pluto TV sign-up/registration flow. In this role, you will help shape how millions of viewers discover films, series, live sports, and news on Paramount+, Pluto TV, and our future streaming products. You will work closely with senior engineers and applied scientists to build and deploy production systems that improve engagement, retention, and viewer satisfaction. This is a highly collaborative technical role where you will contribute to innovation at the intersection of ML modeling, retrieval and ranking systems, embeddings, experimentation, and real-time user understanding.

What You’ll Do

- Contribute to the design and development of personalization in the Paramount+ sign-up flow and Pluto TV registration experiences.

- Help define and lead the multi-year product strategy across Paramount+ and Pluto TV for sign-up flow/registration flow optimization

- Build the specifications to develop real-time, personalized experiences in the sign-up flow (in cases with both low-information and high-information)

- Partner with product, design, content, platform engineering, and data science teams to deliver measurable user outcomes.

- Support the development of semantic search and browse experiences using embeddings, query understanding, and domain-specific model architectures.

- Apply experimentation best practices, including A/B testing and offline evaluation, to inform model and feature improvements.

- Collaborate with and learn from senior engineers and scientists, contributing to a solid and growing Applied ML culture.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on data, machine learning, or highly technical platforms.

- Strong knowledge of machine learning concepts (e.g., recommendation systems, ranking, experimentation) and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Proven track record of spearheading end-to-end product initiatives, from problem definition and strategy through execution, launch, and iteration.

- Experience working closely with engineering, data science, and design teams to deliver data-driven products at scale.

- Fluency in experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing, metric design, and interpreting results to inform product decisions.

- Ability to define clear product requirements, prioritize successfully, and balance short-term wins with long-term platform investments.

- Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and guide decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels.

- Familiarity with data and ML ecosystems (e.g., BigQuery, experimentation platforms, model lifecycle concepts) is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in streaming, media, growth, or user acquisition funnels (e.g., sign-up, onboarding, personalization) is a plus.

Why Join Us

- Impact: Your work will directly shape how hundreds of millions of users get to their content.

- Influence: You will help define our personalization architecture and grow a senior ML team.

- Innovation: Work alongside experts across Core ML, Causal Science, Content Knowledge, and ML Platform.

- Growth: Paramount is investing heavily in personalization and foundational AI capabilities—this is a ground-floor opportunity to build what comes next.

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the   power   to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Brand/Division Overview:
We are the PMO at Paramount Streaming, that boasts unparalleled insight into transforming Agile Teams at Scale. Our program managers, release managers, project managers and scrum masters bring passion to iterative delivery and process while keeping our eyes on the goal and motivating one another to do the same! Our team blends program management, technical architecture, and engineering leadership to keep our platforms stable while continuously evolving them.

Role Details:
We're seeking a Manager, Technical Program Management who can operate as the subject matter expert on our technical architecture, working directly with engineers on implementation, risk, and scope, while coordinating across engineering, product, and business requests. This isn't a role that runs on status updates and timelines; it requires enough technical fluency to catch flawed scoping and surface dependencies before they become rework. This role also leads a team of Project Managers, responsible for their day-to-day workload, growth, and development, and ensuring the team's work stays aligned to architectural priorities.

Your Day-to-Day:
●    Serve as the subject matter expert on core technical architecture, working directly with engineers on how architectural changes get implemented, what they touch, and where they introduce risk.
●    Manage and develop a team of Project Managers, overseeing workload distribution, prioritization across their portfolios, and their growth as program/project managers.
●    Guide requirements-gathering on large architectural initiatives toward an agreed MVP, managing scope creep as multiple teams propose competing approaches.
●    Stand up and lead focused working groups (tiger teams) to execute isolated architectural changes without disrupting the broader platform.
●    Run and facilitate Architecture Intake, a standing forum with engineering leads across architecture and feature teams, reviewing new RFCs before they're committed to the roadmap.
●    Triage daily requests and escalations from feature teams across Paramount Streaming's platforms that depend on shared architecture systems, distinguishing routine asks from signals of deeper dependency issues.
●    Communicate program health, risk, and architectural roadmap status to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications:
●    7+ years of technical program management experience in a complex, matrixed engineering organization, ideally supporting platform or architecture teams rather than feature delivery teams.
●    Prior experience managing or mentoring other program/project managers, with direct people-management responsibility (performance, growth, workload balancing).
●    Demonstrated ability to understand and reason about system architecture deeply enough to evaluate engineering estimates, scoping, and technical tradeoffs directly with engineers, not just track them.
●    Experience running structured technical review processes (e.g., architecture review boards, RFC processes) to drive cross-team alignment on technical direction.
●    Experience managing platform or infrastructure work with dependencies across multiple engineering teams and SRE.
●    Strong judgment on when to escalate, when to push back, and when to let engineering teams self-direct.
●    High proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and technical documentation; strong written and verbal communication with both engineers and leadership.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
●    Familiarity with Next.js, Module Federation, micro-frontend architectures, or similar web platform technologies.
●    Experience in direct-to-consumer streaming, media, or high-traffic web platforms.
●    Background as a software engineer or technical lead prior to moving into program management.
Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

jobs.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the   power   to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Overview:

Paramount+ streams some of the biggest live sports and events in the world, and our Live Services Product (LSP) oversees the backend platform that makes it possible. LSP provides operators with one experience through our Live Events CMS. The live services automations team supports this. They create specialized services to manage provider integrations. They also oversee orchestration, automation, and distribution. Each of these services is separate.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to expand the Live Services Automation area within LSP. This includes systems that automatically process incoming live signal inputs. You will set up and manage channel infrastructure. You will also make sure that each live show element is checked and ready before it goes on air. Finally, you will consistently distribute live content to our target destinations for the Paramount+ experience.

This is a deeply technical, backend-first role. The Live Events CMS owns the operator-facing surface, and you own the domain logic underneath it that extends its functionality through automation with 1st party/3rd part integrations. You'll partner closely with the CMS product owner to make sure the workflows you build surface cleanly through the CMS, and you'll report to the Live Services lead on platform strategy and vision.

Experience with live streaming, broadcast, or real-time systems is strongly preferred. We want someone who understands the ecosystem and its challenges. They should know what works and what might fail during a live event. This knowledge will help them build systems that work well and can recover automatically.

Responsibilities:

Own Backend Platform Strategy

-
Shape and ship the roadmap for the Live Services Platform. Focus on automation, workflows, and links between systems.

-
Build services that scale with every live event. Cover the full path from scheduling to playback and monitoring.

Drive Automation & Orchestration

-
Design automation that removes manual steps from live event setup.

-
Build "self-healing" workflows that boost reliability and cut extra   work.

Lead Integrations Across Systems

-
Own the links between Summit and other systems. This covers scheduling, channels, listings, signal acquisition, and monitoring.

-
Keep data flowing smoothly across internal platforms and third-party services.

Translate Operations into Systems

-
Partner with Live Operations and Engineering. Turn real-time needs into backend  solutions that scale.

-
Spot bottlenecks and design systems that run better at scale.

Define Technical Solutions

-
Write clear product docs with senior engineering and product leads. This covers API contracts, workflows, sequence diagrams, and system designs.

-
Give engineering teams clear direction on architecture, dependencies, and      integration patterns.

Agile Product Ownership

-
Act as Product Owner for a devoted engineering team.

-
Manage the backlog, set priorities, and ship deeply technical platform features.

Cross-Functional Management

-
Align stakeholders across product, engineering, and operations on backend      platform strategy and delivery.

-
Support big live event launches with systems that never miss a beat!

Basic Qualifications:

-
2-4 years in Technical Product Management or a closely related engineering role, with hands-on depth in backend systems, APIs, and/or platform products.

-
A track record of shipping automation, orchestration, or distributed integrations.

-
You should have a solid knowledge of event-driven architecture. You should also know about workflow orchestration and contracts between services.

-
Comfort living in APIs, system links, and data flows; UI experience is not needed.

-
Well-developed technical writing: API specs, sequence diagrams, system workflows.

-
Experience owning a backlog and leading technical delivery on an Agile team.

Additional Qualifications:

-
Live streaming, live sports, or broadcast operations experience — you understand the stakes of a live event and how automation reduces them.

-
Experience integrating third-party data providers (stats, scheduling, listings, or similar feeds) into a platform via versioned contracts.

-
Knowledge of reliability patterns: retries, reconciliation and observability at scale.

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Director, Product Management (CBS Sports Web)
Location: Nashville, TN / New York, NY / Los Angeles, CA Type: Full-Time, On-Site Org: CBS Sports Digital, Product, Design & Engineering

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We've got the brands, we've got the stars, we've got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet. Now all we're missing is
YOU. Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also
enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together we co-create moments that matter, both for our audiences and our employees, and aim to
leave a positive mark on culture.

Overview
Own the product direction for one of the largest sports sites on the internet. CBSSports.com is the front door to CBS Sports for tens of millions of fans. It is where scores, live gametrackers, news, fantasy, and betting come together during the biggest moments in sports: the NFL, March Madness, The Masters, college football, Champions League, and more. This role owns the product strategy for the full web experience. You will lead a small PM team, work directly with design and engineering leads across squads, and stay close to the work. This is a player-coach role. You set the direction, and you're in the details.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Set product strategy for CBSSports.com and translate it into clear priorities teams can act on. Own the web plan. Decide what we're building, sequence the work, balance risk, track outcomes, and make the hard calls on what to
continue, change, or stop.

- Treat web as the reach and discovery engine for CBS Sports. Grow organic and direct traffic, sharpen high-intent surfaces like
gametrackers and scores, and turn anonymous visitors into registered users.

- Own the role web plays in the broader portfolio: growing registered users at scale and converting web audiences into sticky products
like the CBS Sports App.

- Prototype to think. We build working prototypes to remove ambiguity, test ideas with real fans, and learn before we commit. You'll use
tools like Claude and Cursor to make concepts tangible, iterate on what you learn, and arrive at a better strategy because you've held
the thing in your hand.

- Coach and develop 1 to 2 PMs through structured feedback, calibration, and deliberate growth planning.

- Partner with design and engineering directors on cross-squad alignment, delivery cadence, and how we evolve our process.

- Partner with editorial to make web the place where great storytelling and great product meet.

- Represent product to executive leadership. Turn fan behavior, competitive dynamics, and product performance into a clear narrative that builds trust.

How We Build (The Builder Culture)
We've moved past feature factories, PRDs, and slow-motion handoffs. We work in small, cross-functional squads with fixed timeboxes, clear ownership, and a focus on outcomes over output. When we need to figure out whether an idea works, we build a prototype and put
it in front of fans. The goal is not a finished feature. It's removing ambiguity fast enough to make better decisions. AI is how we make this possible. PMs prototype in code using tools like Claude and Cursor. Not to ship production features, but to make
ideas tangible, test them with users, and learn before we commit. Designers do the same. Engineers ship with AI as a pair programmer. We build internal tools with prompts when a workflow can be automated. This is the operating expectation, and as a Director, you'll
model it and push what's possible further. The result is that we move faster than our size suggests. Small teams, short cycles, real signals from real fans, and the autonomy to act on what you learn without waiting for permission.

What success looks like:

- The web product strategy is coherent.

- People across the organization understand what we're building, why, and what we're choosing not
to do.

- Web reliably grows reach, grows registered users, and feeds the rest of the portfolio.

- The funnel from anonymous visitor to registered user to sticky-product user gets measurably stronger.

- High-intent surfaces like gametrackers and scores get sharper and convert better, especially during tentpole events when traffic peaks. Ideas are tested before they're committed.

- Teams prototype, learn from fans, and start building with real clarity.

- Fewer false starts, less rework.
PMs on your team grow their craft visibly and operate with stronger judgment over time.

- Prioritization decisions are defensible, tied to measurable fan impact, and adjusted when the signal says so.

- Stakeholders trust your perspective because you bring receipts, not just opinions.

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years in product, with meaningful time in a leadership role. Consumer web at scale, ideally high-traffic and real-time. You've owned the strategy, shipped against it, and developed other PMs.

Additional Qualifications

- Strong prioritization instincts. You can hold site-level strategy and problem-level detail in the same day.

- Fluency with the levers that move large-scale web: discovery and SEO, performance, identity and authentication, and conversion.

- Comfort prototyping in code with AI tools. You don't need to be an engineer, but you can use Claude or Cursor to build something testable and learn from it.

- Fluency with product analytics, experimentation, and outcome accountability.

- An AI-native working style. You already use LLMs to think through problems and accelerate your own work, and you have a point of view
on how AI changes what a product team can do.

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage.

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.
